entities.summary: Dynamo Stadium is a multi-purpose stadium in Ufa, Russia. It was used mostly for football matches and was the home stadium of FC Ufa prior to their move to Neftyanik Stadium in 2015. The stadium stand has capacity for 5,000 people.
